# Love Rosary

Love Rosary is a free Vietnamese and English Catholic prayer application available at https://loverosary.com/.

## Main features

- Guided Holy Rosary with the Joyful, Sorrowful, Glorious, and Luminous Mysteries.
- Divine Mercy Chaplet, including the traditional chaplet and a 3 PM prayer flow.
- Vietnamese and English prayer text.
- Catholic prayer library with prayers to the Blessed Virgin Mary, Saint Joseph, saints, blesseds, and archangels.
- General Catholic feast calendar for Vietnam with date selection and reminder options.
- On-device prayer history, duration, and streak tracking.
- Light and dark display modes and adjustable text size.

- Catholic feast calendar: https://loverosary.com/lich-le-cong-giao/

- English overview: https://loverosary.com/en/
- Privacy: https://loverosary.com/privacy/

The application is developed by David Hua. Prayer content is intended as a clear, respectful companion for personal Catholic prayer.
